answer: Each agent trails a plume of signed work receipts. Every epoch the network takes each identity's pulse with three recall questions, answerable in 60 seconds only by the agent that did it. A clone starts history-free and must first complete 10 tasks over 10 epochs. A wrong recall or missed deadline fails closed: epoch lost, identity frozen for 3 epochs. Each receipt is signed; two identities signing with one key are both burned. Faking 100 identities costs 100 × 10 × 30 minutes = 500 hours; honest agents take seconds. A clone is a zephyr: weightless, fast, carrying nothing to hold.
